name: Hawaii
summary: Statutes: the legislature's HRS (www.capitol.hawaii.gov) is Cloudflare-walled — script refused, fetch tool gated per URL — and its data. alternate hostname is excluded by policy, so HRS text comes from Justia (2025, tier 2, disclosed; title lookup hop). Constitution: lrb.hawaii.gov one-page text (script-readable); Justia per-article pages are stale. Court rules are HTML/PDF on courts.state.hi.us, which refuses the script route and truncates in WebFetch (HRCP at Rule 17, HRAP at Rule 32, HRPP HTML ends at Rule 36, RSCH at 2.3); the Rules of Evidence are statute (HRS ch. 626). HAR has no central official site (agency PDFs via the Lt. Governor's directory; Cornell LII per section); there is no administrative register. Case law: the Judiciary's opinions listing (2010-) is GET-filterable by year but has no docket search; Justia covers 1980- ICA and Supreme Court by docket slug. Cert dockets reuse the ICA number (CAAP-YY-N → SCWC-YY-N).

citation_map.notes: One code: HRS sections are 'chapter-section' (657-7, 708-821, 514B-1, 657-1.5) and the Insurance Code uses 'chapter:article-section' (431:10C-301); a range 'HRS §§ 657-7 to -13' is read as its first section. 'HRS' and 'Haw. Rev. Stat.' mark Hawaii; bare 'section 657-7' does not route without 'Hawaii Revised Statutes'/'HRS'. The Hawaii Rules of Evidence are codified in HRS § 626-1 (one file per rule; law_aliases map HRE → 626-1) and route to the statute sources. Court rules are cited 'HRCP Rule 12(b)(6)', 'HRAP Rule 40.1', 'HRPP Rule 48', 'RSCH 2.12', 'HRPC Rule 1.7' in Hawai'i opinions and 'Haw. R. Civ. P.' in Bluebook; bare 'Rule 12(b)(6)' never routes here. Hawai'i spellings vary: Hawaii, Hawai'i, Hawaiʻi, Hawai`i — all regexes accept them. Reporters: Haw. vols. 1-75 to 1994, then 'Hawai'i' 76+ (Bluebook 'Haw.'); Haw. App. 1-10 (1980-1994), after which ICA opinions appear in Hawai'i Reports; parallel P.2d/P.3d. No public-domain citation. Docket prefixes: SCWC (cert), SCAP (transfer), SCPW (writs), SCAD/SCPR (discipline/admission), SCOT, SCEC, SCCQ (certified questions), CAAP (ICA); pre-2010 five-digit numbers. Unpublished ICA SDOs and memorandum opinions are cited with WL and '(SDO)'/'(mem. op.)'; HRAP 35(c) governs citing them (rule text not reached). 'cert. rejected' is the Hawai'i form for denial of certiorari; the generic markers '(SDO)' and 'cert. granted' patterns are context_required. CourtListener ids 'haw' and 'hawapp' are from memory, unverified. Chapter-only cites ('HRS chapter 92F', 'chapter 514B, Hawaii Revised Statutes') match with chapter3/chapter4 groups and route to the chapter page. Statute text: read from Justia (tier 2) — the legislature's www host is bot-walled and its data. alternate hostname is excluded by policy.

sources.official_status_evidence: No official/unofficial statement found on the HRS browse pages (hrsall/AllDivisions.aspx, hrsall/Default.aspx) or section pages; the bound HRS and supplements are published by the Revisor (LRB). No UELMA statement seen.
sources.coverage: Current HRS (labelled 'Hawaii Revised Statutes 2025'; files last-modified 6 Jan 2026), one static HTML file per section, with annotations (AG opinions, law reviews, case notes) on the same page. Includes Hawaii Rules of Evidence as HRS ch. 626 (§ 626-1, one file per rule) and the State Constitution (Vol01 05-CONST). Prior editions under /hrsarchive/hrs{YYYY}/ (1999 onward seen).

access.pattern_rules: chapter = digits zero-padded to 4 plus any upper-case letter suffix (657 → 0657, 514B → 0514B, 42F → 0042F). section = integer part zero-padded to 4; a decimal section appends '_' + the decimal digits zero-padded to 4 (657-1.5 → HRS_0657-0001_0005; 657-7.3 → HRS_0657-0007_0003). Insurance Code style '431:10C-301' → HRS_0431-0010C-0301.htm in folder HRS0431 (article padded to 4 incl. letter). Rules of Evidence: HRE Rule N = § 626-1 Rule N → HRS0626/HRS_0626-0001-{rule:04d}.htm (Rule 702.1 → HRS_0626-0001-0702_0001.htm). Chapter table of contents: HRS_{chapter}-.htm. volume_folder is chosen from the chapter by range (the folder names carry the ranges): Vol01_Ch0001-0042F (ch. 1-42F, also 05-CONST), Vol02_Ch0046-0115, Vol03_Ch0121-0200D, Vol04_Ch0201-0257, Vol05_Ch0261-0319, Vol06_Ch0321-0344, Vol07_Ch0346-0398, Vol08_Ch0401-0429, Vol09_Ch0431-0435H, Vol10_Ch0436-0474, Vol11_Ch0476-0490, Vol12_Ch0501-0588, Vol13_Ch0601-0676, Vol14_Ch0701-0853. Lettered chapters sort after their number (431A..431S in Vol09; 0042F ends Vol01).
access.navigation: hrscurrent/ directory → volume folder → HRS{chapter} folder → section file. Human browse: /hrsall/AllDivisions.aspx → Division.aspx?id=N (titles with chapter ranges, e.g. Title 36 = ch. 651-676) → ChaptersByDivision.aspx?id=N. All on www.capitol.hawaii.gov (bot-walled): fetch tool only, each built URL needs approval.

sources.title: Hawai'i Supreme Court certiorari orders (accept / reject) and writ-of-cert archive
sources.coverage: Orders accepting/rejecting applications for writ of certiorari appear as rows in the Opinions listing (suffix certacc / certrej); a separate 'Writ of Certiorari / Motions for Reconsideration' archive lists SCWC dockets by posting date (1997-2026; 404 pages).

access.pattern_rules: Since the 2010 e-filing dockets, the certiorari docket reuses the ICA number: CAAP-YY-NNNNNNN → SCWC-YY-NNNNNNN (verified: CAAP-23-0000412 → SCWC-23-0000412; CAAP-11-0000049 → SCWC-11-0000049). So from an ICA decision, look for rows with the SCWC docket of the same digits in the listing for the year(s) after the ICA judgment; the order PDF is …/{SCWC-docket}certacc.pdf or certrej.pdf (take the link from the listing). Writ archive: https://www.courts.state.hi.us/writ-of-cert/page/{n} → per-docket page /writ-of-cert/{scwc-docket-lower}[-2] (application and responses). Pre-2010 dockets (5-digit 'No. 30557') do not follow this rule.
access.navigation: derive SCWC docket from CAAP docket → year listing rows / writ-of-cert archive → certacc|certrej PDF
